fields.hero.heading: Request a Titanium Dioxide Quote
fields.hero.body: Tell us the product, application, quantity and destination you are evaluating. Our team will review your requirements and prepare the appropriate commercial response.
fields.form.heading: Quotation request details
fields.form.intro: Required fields are marked. Please use business information and avoid confidential formulations, account credentials, payment details or sensitive personal information.
fields.field.grade.label: Product / Grade
fields.field.application.label: Application
fields.field.quantity.label: Required Quantity
fields.field.destination-country.label: Destination Country
fields.field.destination-port-city.label: Destination Port / City (optional)
fields.field.destination-port-city.helper: Add this only if it is already known.
fields.field.company-name.label: Company Name
fields.field.contact-name.label: Your Name
fields.field.business-email.label: Business Email
fields.field.business-email.helper: Use the business email where we can respond to this request.
fields.field.phone-whatsapp.label: Phone / WhatsApp (optional)
fields.field.website.label: Website (optional)
fields.field.additional-requirements.label: Additional Requirements (optional)
fields.field.additional-requirements.helper: Add any non-confidential specification, packaging, schedule, document or other context that may help us review the request.
fields.validation.summary.heading: Please review the highlighted fields.
fields.validation.summary.body: Correct the information below and try again. Your other entries are still here.
fields.validation.error.grade-required: Select a product or grade, or choose “Not sure / Need help.”
fields.validation.error.destination-country-lon: Keep the destination country to 100 characters or fewer.
fields.validation.error.destination-port-city-l: Keep the destination port or city to 120 characters or fewer.
fields.validation.error.company-name-long: Keep your company name to 160 characters or fewer.
fields.validation.error.contact-name-long: Keep your name to 100 characters or fewer.
fields.validation.error.business-email-invalid: Enter a business email in the format name@company.com.
fields.validation.error.phone-whatsapp-long: Keep the phone or WhatsApp number to 40 characters or fewer.
fields.validation.error.website-invalid: Enter a complete website address or remove this optional value.
fields.validation.error.additional-requirements: Keep additional requirements to 2,000 characters or fewer.

fields.failure.body: Your information is still here. Please try again.

fields.success.body: Our team will review the details and contact you using the information provided.
fields.unavailable.heading: The quotation request form is temporarily unavailable.
fields.unavailable.body: No request has been submitted. Please return later and try again.
fields.other.heading: Other request types
fields.other.intro: Use the separate request form when you need a sample review or controlled document request instead of a quotation.
fields.seo.title: Request a Titanium Dioxide Quote | TiO2 Malaysia
fields.seo.description: Request a titanium dioxide quotation from TiO2 Malaysia by providing your grade, application, quantity in metric tonnes and destination for review.
